data.desc: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. ('Alpha Modus' or the 'Company') (NASDAQ: AMOD) is a vertical AI company focused on real-time, in-store shopper engagement and attribution. Its patented 'closed-loop' retail AI framework, Sense Decide Deliver Attribute, enables brands and retailers to measure the full impact of digital content, physical interactions, and transaction outcomes. Through subsidiaries like Alpha Modus, Corp. and Alpha Modus Financial Services, LLC., the company is actively deploying technologies that merge artificial intelligence, retail media, and financial access across the physical retail landscape.
